'''Tull''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Reclamation Service]], a [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] unit charged with discovering and recovering ancient artifacts for [[Weapon/Legends|weaponization]] against the Empire's enemies, in the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Major/Legends|major]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was knowledgeable of the workings of [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[hypergate]]s and advised Imperial forces on them during the conflict on [[Seline]].

==Behind the scenes==
Tull was mentioned once in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the Ancient Hypergate Warzone released in Game Update 1.6 "Ancient Hypergate" in [[2012]], a [[Sith Lord]] non player character announcer mentions Major Tull, who subsequently appears in the game listed as Imperial Reclamation Officer and gives player characters an in-character explanation of the gameplay mechanics of the warzone.<ref name="Ancient Hypergate" />
